brand._source: [CONFIRM] Brand palette and fonts from the company's logo or style guide.

sender._confirm: Confirm the reply-to inbox the comms lead wants replies in.

team._confirm: Direct phones for every manager (all rows currently fall back to the main line).

fees._confirm: Confirm before fees appear in owner copy.

newsletter.referral_line: Know another property owner in your market? Introductions are the best thanks we get.
newsletter.company_block: [CONFIRM] Two or three sentences on what changed this month.

recommendation_rules.when: lease ends within 90 days and rent is within 5% of market
recommendation_rules.stance: Recommend renewing at the current rent.

recommendation_rules.when: lease ends within 90 days and rent is more than 5% below market
recommendation_rules.stance: Propose an increase toward market, capped at 5% unless the company says otherwise.

recommendation_rules.when: lease ends within 90 days and rent is more than 5% above market
recommendation_rules.stance: Recommend renewing flat; a turn would likely reprice down.

recommendation_rules.when: a unit has been vacant more than 30 days
recommendation_rules.stance: Name the pricing or condition change being made to lease it.

recommendation_rules.when: a tenant balance exceeds one month of rent
recommendation_rules.stance: State the collection step under way and the next date.

compare._note: What the 'How you compare' section may cite. Collections and the owner survey always show when the data is loaded. Renewals show only when the company is within renewal_within_pct of the verified-PM median.

newsletter._certifications_note: Pull certifications from the PM.com profile each quarter; delete the list to drop the sentence.
newsletter._show_rent_vs_market_note: Market comparisons come from AppFolio's Computed Market Rent. Set false to hide every market comparison until the team trusts the field.
newsletter._report_link_note: Set true once a host exists at report_base_url; the pages and the button come back.

_watch_tags_note: Owner-directory Tags that mark a cohort worth a scripted touch. Counted in the radar's Patterns section, not scored per owner.
